name: August
title: Where to go on holiday in August
intro: August is the busiest month for holidays from the UK. Here's where's at its best, from cool mountains and northern coasts to safari and Bali's dry season.
seo_title: Where is hot in August? Summer holiday ideas

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
August is the hottest and busiest month of the year in southern Europe. The Greek islands, Turkey, Cyprus, southern Spain and southern Italy are 29 to 34°C, the sea is at its warmest, around 25 to 27°C, and almost every resort is full. Italy and France take their own holidays this month too, so the coasts are crowded and prices are at their peak.

The places we rate best in August are the ones that stay warm without baking: the Alps, the lakes, northern Spain, Scandinavia and the Baltics. The classic Mediterranean beach resorts are listed above as "Also good in August": still great for heat, but hot and busy.

The temperatures below are average daytime highs for August, rounded. Flight times are typical direct flights from London.

sections.heading: The ranking at a glance: hottest beaches
sections.text:
If you want heat and the warmest sea of the year, within about four and a half hours:

- **1. [Antalya](/destinations/antalya) and [Kaş](/destinations/kas), Turkey:** around 34°C. About 4 hours.
- **2. [Corfu](/destinations/corfu), [Saranda](/destinations/saranda) and [Paphos](/destinations/paphos):** around 32°C. 3 to 4 hours 30 minutes.
- **3. [Rhodes](/destinations/rhodes), [Kefalonia](/destinations/kefalonia), [Zakynthos](/destinations/zakynthos) and [Bodrum](/destinations/bodrum):** around 31°C. 3 hours 15 minutes to 4 hours.
- **4. [Mallorca](/destinations/mallorca), [Málaga](/destinations/malaga), [Valencia](/destinations/valencia), [Malta](/destinations/malta) and [Split](/destinations/split):** around 31°C. 2 hours 15 minutes to 3 hours.
- **5. [Menorca](/destinations/menorca), [Ibiza](/destinations/ibiza), [Dubrovnik](/destinations/dubrovnik) and [Kotor](/destinations/kotor):** around 30°C. 2 hours 15 minutes to 3 hours.
- **6. [Crete](/destinations/crete), the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve), [Lisbon](/destinations/lisbon) and [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife):** around 29°C, often breezy. 2 hours 45 minutes to 4 hours 15 minutes.

sections.heading: Warm, not too hot
sections.text:
For long sunny days without the 34°C heat:

- **Lakes:** [Lake Ohrid](/destinations/lake-ohrid) is around 29°C, [Ljubljana](/destinations/ljubljana) and [Lake Bled](/destinations/lake-bled) around 25 to 27°C, and [Annecy](/destinations/annecy) around 26°C, with lakes warm enough to swim in.
- **Mountains:** [Interlaken](/destinations/interlaken), [Innsbruck](/destinations/innsbruck), [Chamonix](/destinations/chamonix), [Zermatt](/destinations/zermatt) and the [Dolomites](/destinations/dolomites) are around 20 to 25°C, perfect for walking, cable cars and mountain lakes.
- **The Atlantic:** the [Azores](/destinations/azores) are around 26°C, and [Asturias](/destinations/asturias) in green northern Spain around 24°C, with beaches that are far quieter than the south.
- **City breaks:** [Berlin](/destinations/berlin), [Kraków](/destinations/krakow), [Amsterdam](/destinations/amsterdam) and [Copenhagen](/destinations/copenhagen) are around 21 to 25°C, much more comfortable for sightseeing than Rome or Madrid.

sections.heading: Cool escapes
sections.text: The [Norwegian fjords](/destinations/norwegian-fjords), [Stockholm](/destinations/stockholm), [Tallinn](/destinations/tallinn) and [Riga](/destinations/riga) are around 18 to 22°C. [Iceland](/destinations/iceland-ring-road) is around 14°C, with puffins until mid-August and every highland road open. The [Wild Atlantic Way](/destinations/wild-atlantic-way) in Ireland is around 19°C, with long evenings and no jet lag.

sections.heading: Long-haul in August
sections.text:
- **Indonesia and Malaysia:** [Bali](/destinations/bali), [Lombok](/destinations/lombok) and [Borneo](/destinations/borneo) are dry and around 30 to 31°C.
- **Safari:** the great migration is usually in the [Maasai Mara](/destinations/maasai-mara) in August, and [Zanzibar](/destinations/zanzibar) and [Namibia](/destinations/namibia) are in their dry season.
- **North America:** [California](/destinations/los-angeles), the Canadian Rockies around [Banff](/destinations/banff), [Vancouver](/destinations/vancouver) and [Québec City](/destinations/quebec-city) are all at their best.

The Caribbean and Florida are hot and humid, in the middle of hurricane season. Thailand's west coast is in its rainy season, though [Koh Samui](/destinations/koh-samui) on the east coast is usually drier.

sections.heading: How to choose
sections.text:
For heat and a warm sea, Greece, Turkey and the Balearics are all reliable, but book as early as you can. For warm days without the heat and the crowds, the lakes and mountains of the Alps and Slovenia are the best-kept secret of the summer. If you can travel in the last week of August, after many European holidays end, the coasts start to get quieter. Our [summer holidays](/destinations/summer-holidays) page has more ideas.

If you're choosing as a family or group and everyone wants something different, put a few of these on a shortlist and let everyone vote with points. That's what somewhere🎉 is for, and our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday) explains how it works.

faqs.question: Where is good to go in August that isn't too hot?
faqs.answer: Asturias, the Azores, the Alps (Annecy, Interlaken), Lake Ohrid, the Lofoten Islands, Iceland, the Faroe Islands and Canada are warm but comfortable. In the US, San Diego is milder than most of the country.

faqs.question: Is August a good time for safari?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Maasai Mara's Great Migration and Namibia's dry season make August one of the best months for wildlife, though it's also the busiest, so book early.

faqs.question: How can we make an August holiday cheaper?
faqs.answer: Fly midweek, go somewhere slightly less obvious (Gdańsk instead of Barcelona, Asturias instead of the Costa del Sol), or look at the last week of August when prices start to drop.

faqs.question: Where is the hottest place in Europe in August?
faqs.answer: Southern Spain, Greece and Turkey. Seville and the Turkish coast around Antalya average around 34 to 36°C, and Cyprus and the Greek islands around 31 to 32°C.

faqs.question: Where is warm but not too hot in August?
faqs.answer: The Alps, the Slovenian and Italian lakes, the Azores and northern Spain are around 20 to 27°C. Scandinavia and the Baltics are around 18 to 22°C.

faqs.question: Where is quiet in August?
faqs.answer: The Azores, Asturias, Lake Ohrid and the Baltic capitals are far less crowded than the Mediterranean coast. In the Alps, smaller villages are quieter than the big resorts.
